The pattern was found by an agent scanning the card's transaction window for same-band bursts.

sar.narrative: Customer C05560, holder of card C05560-K2, is the subject of this report following a monitoring alert for structuring. Between 2016-12-06 11:16 and 2016-12-06 11:23, three online transactions totaling $1,499.84 were executed on card C05560-K2 using the device profile 'rv:11.0 |  | ie 11.0 for desktop | '. The specific online purchases comprised $499.98 (transaction 3518540 on 2016-12-06 11:16), $499.95 (transaction 3518547 on 2016-12-06 11:21), and $499.91 (transaction 3518549 on 2016-12-06 11:23). This activity is suspicious because three online purchases occurred within seven minutes, with each amount kept just under a $500 authorization threshold between $400 and $500. Although the device profile had 13 prior transactions on this card and transaction 3518549 fell within the card's usual range, the card had one confirmed fraud case in the 45 days before the alert (CC-5305), indicating it may still be compromised. Furthermore, eight of the eight most similar closed cases were confirmed fraud, including cases CC-2476, CC-0606, CC-3624, and CC-3707, despite a case-memory model score of 0.059 and a bank risk score of 0.24. In response to this activity, the bank executed an automated case creation and analyst escalation, and recommended L1 and L2 actions to block card C05560-K2 and file this regulatory report.
